testcase.name: Scenario: Open a group from the title-only ribbon: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:23:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open a group from the title-only ribbon ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part document is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full View ribbon is visible ✔ When the user opens the ribbon display menu ✔ Then Minimize to Panel Buttons is selected ✔ When the user selects Minimize to Panel Titles ✔ Then the View ribbon displays group titles in a narrow strip ✔ When the user selects the Windows group title ✔ Then a temporary panel displays the Windows commands ✔ When the user activates the ribbon display control ✔ Then the full View ribbon is restored ✔ And the temporary Windows panel closes ✔ When the user opens the ribbon display menu again ✔ Then Minimize to Panel Titles is selected ✔ When the user selects Minimize to Panel Buttons ✔ Then the View ribbon displays compact group buttons ✔ When the user activates the ribbon display control again ✔ Then the full View ribbon is restored
